scholarly_epigraphic_synthesis.source: Leah Mascia, A Journey Through the Multilingual Landscape of Oxyrhynchus, synthesizing Jean-Claude Goyon 2018, Les inscriptions du petit mobilier funeraire, pp.197-210
scholarly_epigraphic_synthesis.script_caution: Goyon notes that the cursive writing is difficult to classify, with ductus near abnormal hieratic, old Demotic, or Demotic of the 2nd/1st centuries BCE; poor preservation prevents clear interpretation of much of the corpus.
scholarly_epigraphic_synthesis.orientation_function: inscriptions on cones and limestone boxes containing bullae and sealed by pyramidal lids are associated with orientation of loculi containing Osirian figurines
scholarly_epigraphic_synthesis.other_corpus_theme: some inscriptions refer to Osiris as guardian of the West

functional_interpretation.source_layer: scholarly comparison with Mysteries of Osiris / Khoiak ritual tradition
functional_interpretation.supported_function: bullae inside containers protect Osiris, repel Seth and other malevolent entities, and thereby support completion of ritual renaissance/rebirth
functional_interpretation.not_claimed: This is not asserted as a verbatim translation of each UE15307 box inscription.

next_decisive_gate.strong_pass_condition: All six boxes receive source-bound ficha + transcription/translation + direction/deity/function mappings where legible.

epistemic_firewall: Six physical boxes do not imply six cardinal directions.
The four-direction deity matrix is corpus-level scholarly synthesis and must not be assigned object-by-object without a source join.
The direct 'west' reading belongs to ficha 60, not automatically to ficha 345 or UE15307.
Protective/rebirth function is a scholarly ritual interpretation, not a verbatim translation of every box inscription.
Oxyrhynchus is a comparative control only; no morphology, provenance or assembly mechanics may be transferred to Mendes, CG53469, pBrooklyn, or Dendera without independent evidence.
No surviving biological Osiris relic claim follows from this material.
canonical_seal: THE CLOSED NICHE PRESERVES A REAL CONTAINER-BALL-INSCRIPTION PROTECTIVE SYSTEM. THE CORPUS SHOWS CARDINAL GUARDIAN LOGIC. THE SIX UE15307 BOXES ARE NOT YET INDIVIDUALLY DECODED. DO NOT INVENT THE MISSING JOINS.
